title: The upstream writes a prefix and holds the socket open: the delivery deadline ends the fetch, and the attempt is not retried
notes: The stall prefix is 300 bytes here; the catalog self-test uses 8192 with a 2000 ms delivery idle timeout, and the exact prefix is not part of the contract. What the fixture fixes is the outcome: the Worker's host-route fetch ends with the typed PDSH_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT error, the attempt is not retried (the catalog asserts a model-request ceiling), and the gateway raises no ModelGatewayError because the upstream body never completed. No terminating chunk is ever written, so the response is never committed to the response log; that point is unmeasured rather than asserted.
